notes: Matched-vs-text comparisons use identical Qwen3.5-2B template, hidden token, split, Ridge, and cascade costs.
The Flux probe cost is fully included and the probe image is reused when flux4b_4steps is selected.
Charged conditions add the analytical Qwen3.5-2B evaluator TFLOPs to every action; information-only cascade conditions are retained as ablations.
Qwen3-VL-8B@320px cached features are refit under exactly the same 2000/200 split for a resolution-controlled compression reference.
Analytical FLOPs omit norm, activation, rotary, softmax, preprocessing, and minor elementwise gates; they are not hardware latency.
